clauses.current_legal_basis: The held Federal Register original (34 FR 8349, 1969-05-30) was read in full: it makes standing designations with no end date, condition or sunset, and no held later instrument amends, revokes or supersedes it. Bounded machine searches read for coverage and judged adequate for this order: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121, citations of the order by number in statute text and notes, edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML, text naming the order), and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records and operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts naming the order as amended, revoked or superseded). Each returned 0 hits for EO 11471, and the only held texts that cite the order by number are the original and the 1989 OFR codification note.
clauses.reason: The sole operative paragraph of the held original designates the Department of State as the Central Authority for requests for service under the Convention on the Service Abroad of Judicial and Extrajudicial Documents (Sec. 1), designates the Department of State, the Department of Justice and the United States Marshal or Deputy Marshal of the judicial district of service as authorities to complete the certificate (Sec. 2), and authorizes the Secretary of State, with the Attorney General's concurrence for designations of Justice officers, to make additional designations or modify these designations (Sec. 3). The text states no end date or terminating condition, and the designations are standing ones rather than a one-time act with a performance date. No held later instrument amends or revokes any of the three sections.

research_rationale:
EO 11471 (34 FR 8349) is a three-section order of May 28, 1969 that designates United States authorities for the Hague Service Convention. The held original was read in full and confirmed to be the order (number, date, title and signature line agree). The single clause covers the whole order. The order has no own-terms end, no held later amendment, revocation or supersession, and the three bounded searches found no hit, so the standing designations are carried as operative through 2026-10-14 on the established original-plus-bounded-search route.
